title: Use my own harness without a bundled integration
statement: As a harness author or integration contributor, I can supply my harness integration definition and an installed binary so that I can use Cordyceps with my harness without first contributing it to the bundled suite.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A consumer can provide a custom harness definition and an already-installed binary without that harness being bundled with Cordyceps.
For a supported definition and provider protocol, the real binary can reach the Cordyceps mock backend and process a response prescribed through the existing library API.
